A simple notice, overnight
A patient evening is easier with a plan
Urgent notice for travelers with pets

Travelers must review companion-animal arrangements before arrival and keep documents ready for inspection. Please use the Companion Animal Travel Desk at once if your pet needs special handling, if a carrier is damaged, or if your route changes.

The safety coordinator has checked the main risks and has asked travelers to keep pets calm, leashed, and close under supervision. <<FACT F016>> Bring food, water, and any required papers in an easy-to-reach pouch, and tell staff immediately if your pet shows distress. Simple preparation helps prevent delays and protects every animal in the terminal.

Aurelia Skyways is committed to steady, careful support for traveling pets and their owners. If you need direction, proceed to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for immediate help.
